scope: Bounded continuation after two observed numerical negatives; not a retrospectively preregistered protocol for those first runs.
source_fixture: tc-real-ffn-fixture-v1; layer 0; complete [1024,4096,12288] FFN; original checkpoint weights and nine-point capture campaign
diagnostic_control: CPU_ONLY policy on the original frozen monolithic sigmoid graph; not a speed candidate
production_promotion: none; component results cannot qualify a full request or new default
rules: Never change the reference or gates to rescue a candidate.
A failed numerical arm retains its samples but receives no speedup statistic.
Stop a candidate on its first fixed numerical failure; keep the failure artifact.
Only numerically passing discovery candidates advance to a separate held-out run.
Prefer the existing fused GPU baseline if no complete consumer improvement is confirmed.
